text: Phase 3 items 1, 4, 5 landed. (1) Public rectangular plans: plan_geometry(x, at, over, right=) compiles cross-axis plans (codec field, distinct left/right spaces, directed-pairing requirement, metric refusal with named capability); evaluate_geometry(plan, pair_query(...)) executes query-first and matches a direct oracle to 1e-12; geometry(plan) materializes a rectangular effect_form with exact total=coherent+configuration recomposition; query_geometry parity with the fused route; two-sided source-session summaries normalized so receipts stay canonical. New test-rectangular-plan.R. (4) Export pruning: pairing_marginals, metric_components, materialize_metric, compile_metric_schedule, coherent_functional internalized (roxygen/NAMESPACE/pkgdown/tests updated); measurement_space/measurement_bridge/reverse_bridge/inner_product RETAINED because the frozen-vocabulary certification test and open bead bd-01KZYS7XH6G12QV8EYT561EPS3 record a deliberate decision to wire rather than prune them. (5) Introspection: exported sampling_capabilities(plan, fit) with per-reason why/remedy table and print method; plan print now shows metric status, generalization axis, endpoint independence. Full suite: 2121+ assertions, 0 failures. Remaining: item 2 coupling-from-plan vocabulary, item 3 naming unification.
